title: BillingRecord
description: Billing-cycle context used by the Live Billing Monitor for anomaly comparison and by Stage 1/2 as grounding evidence. The POC's 'baseline_avg_daily_spend' is a simplification — see the note on that field before building the real version.

current_cycle_start.description: Start date of the customer's current billing cycle. Anomaly-window day-counting is relative to this.

current_mrc_billed_last_cycle.description: Recurring monthly charge actually billed last cycle. Compared against a newly-posted MRC_POSTED event to detect promo expiry / recurring-charge changes. NOTE: assumes exactly one recurring charge line per customer — confirm this holds for bundled multi-product accounts, or this needs to become an array.

baseline_avg_daily_spend.description: SIMPLIFICATION IN THE POC: a single flat average, hand-set per mock customer. For a real system this should be a computed rolling statistic (e.g. trailing-90-day average variable spend, recalculated on a schedule), not a static field — decide in Sprint 1 whether this is computed by the Billing system itself and exposed as a field, or computed by the monitor from raw historical events. That's an architecture decision, not just a schema field, and it affects where the compute cost and staleness risk sit.
